data.long_meaning: Anabal is a Greek name derived from the words ‘ana’ meaning ‘up’ and ‘ballein’ meaning ‘to throw’. The name Anabal signifies a graceful mountain, symbolizing strength and ascent. In Christian tradition, it may also represent the mountain of God, Mount Zion, where God's presence is most felt. The name Anabal carries the meaning “Graceful mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Anabal usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anabal total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: The name Anabal may be considered unique, especially in modern times, as it is not commonly used in the English-speaking world. It has historical and cultural ties to ancient Greece, adding an element of exoticism and claim to a rich heritage in a multicultural society.
data.spiritual_significance: Anabal, as a Christian name, carries a strong spiritual meaning, especially for those who value the historical and biblical connections to the Greek words underlying the name. It serves as a reminder of the spiritual ascent towards God, and the ongoing pursuit of personal growth and transformation in the Christian faith.
